scope: Unchanged Windows SDK bitmap color GUI translated into Wasm inside browser with actual Wine base DLLs. Startup validates 217 desktop Wine pixel-write cases and actual raw DIB bytes. Six stages in EXE/ZIP/catalog modes compare 156160 drawing-area pixels for seven bitmap formats, RGB and palette colors, direct indices, boundary values and clipping. Universal Windows/DLL compatibility remains incomplete.
oracleReference: Wine 11 desktop x86 macOS; native SetPixel/GetPixel and raw selected DIB bytes with initial DWORD 0x70406080
